# Kahn1

> Kahn1 is an open-source "System 1" decision engine built on a fine-tuned Qwen2.5-3B. It takes a text (the state) and typed questions (Choice, Score, Noul) and returns, for each question, a typed value and a calibrated probability distribution read from the logits of the option tokens. It generates no text, so schema errors cannot happen. MIT license, by Axel Montzamir.

Key results (v3 checkpoint, 14,663 held-out items, k = 3 permutations, temperature calibration, one RTX 5070 Ti with vLLM): 70.3% overall accuracy; Choice 90.9% (banking77 91.1%, MASSIVE 90.8%); Score 51.5% exact on 5-level scales (SST-5 95.2% within one level, Spearman 0.834); Noul 67.0% (RTE 82.7%, SciTail 65.0%); median latency 36.4 ms, p95 82.6 ms. External JevBench: 67.5% (easy 100%, original 84.7%, hard 42.3%).

Kahn1 vs JEV 1.13.0 (TypeSafe API). On the 14,663 Kahn1 held-out items, same prompts, JEV run through its API: Kahn1 70.3%, JEV 67.3%; Choice 90.9% vs 80.1%, Score 51.4% vs 52.0%, Noul 67.0% vs 74.4% (JEV asked whether the text supports the statement). On the 231 public JevBench items, Jev's outcomes as published by JevBench: Jev 86.6%, Kahn1 67.5%; hard tier 73.0% vs 42.3%. JEV median round trip 248 ms over the network; Kahn1 36.4 ms on a local GPU.

Caveats: a 3B model, not a frontier model; Noul is the weakest primitive; calibration was fitted on the training distribution and should be redone on your domain; confidence is the distance from a uniform guess, not the probability of being right.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://kahn1.com/): what Kahn1 is, use cases, caveats, benchmark results
- [Accueil (français)](https://kahn1.com/fr/): la même page en français
- [Benchmarks](https://kahn1.com/benchmarks/): every result, Kahn1 vs JEV on the same items, latency, how to reproduce
- [Résultats (français)](https://kahn1.com/fr/resultats/): les mêmes résultats en français
- [Setup prompt for AI agents](https://kahn1.com/get-started/setup-prompt.md): paste into Claude Code or any coding agent to install and test Kahn1
- [Get started](https://kahn1.com/get-started/): install, serve, API, response format, calibration
- [Démarrer (français)](https://kahn1.com/fr/demarrer/): le même guide en français
- [Playground](https://kahn1.com/playground/): ask typed questions about any text, model in the browser (WebGPU) or on your server
- [Kahn1 plays Snake](https://kahn1.com/snake/): one Choice question per tick, the move read from the logits
